purpose: DEVELOPER COMPARISON ONLY - NOT A RELEASE HOLDOUT

dataset.name: WasItAIGenerated Frontier Image & Video Benchmark (October 2026)
dataset.selection: label-ai-frontier-dev-v1; hash-selected per generator, source-distinct genuine assets, paired original/Instagram images; 3 generated/3 genuine clips

runtime.engine: ONNX Runtime Web/WASM with exact pinned model and WASM, Node 24 Linux x64

notes: Image originals and Instagram renditions are dependent; they must not be pooled as independent evidence.
Dataset authors removed image metadata. This tests statistical scores rather than C2PA provenance.
Development sample only; no claim of training disjointness, unseen-generator independence, difficult-negative category coverage or representative prevalence.
Scores are uncalibrated diagnostics: image sigmoid(logit), video lower-quartile frame score. The latter is not a learned clip posterior.
The current policy deliberately abstained on every sample. Candidate threshold .99 is a fixed diagnostic from the existing policy; .5 is shown for comparison, not selected as a release threshold.
Pixel acquisition uses local Pillow and ffmpeg, with video size/cadence approximating the extension. Native browser behavior is a separate acceptance gate.

candidateComparison.purpose: one bounded development-only comparison on the same 38 originals
candidateComparison.license: MIT declared by publisher; underlying training-data rights not reviewed
candidateComparison.preprocessing: bilinear 440 short edge, center crop 384, CLIP mean [0.48145466, 0.4578275, 0.40821073], std [0.26862954, 0.26130258, 0.27577711] as pinned model.json; local Pillow RGBA
